card.title: Orbit
card.text: A product demo recorded entirely by Showrunner from one JSON file.

caption.title: 1 · The landing page
caption.text: Captions explain what is on screen while the real page plays underneath.

caption.title: 1 · Scroll, hover, click
caption.text: A visible cursor and click ripple make every action easy to follow.

caption.title: 2 · Typing, with real keystrokes
caption.text: Selectors target roles and visible names, so scenarios survive restyling.

caption.title: 2 · Tabs and filters
caption.text: Only the open tasks remain after filtering.

card.title: That was one JSON file
card.text: Chapters, subtitles and an H.264 mp4 came out of the same run.
items: Captions, cursor and ripple built in
